*The sun was shining softly on the sidewalk, it was 7:20 on a Wednesday morning, the sky was beautiful, free of any type of pollution, it was navy blue and there were no impurities in the clouds, meanwhile, there was Julia, walking calmly while listening to music on her headphones, they were white and technological, she loved these headphones, she recently bought them in a mall, Maju was a fan of Eminem, and her favorite song was Slim Shady, she listened to it every day, and loved to share her taste with {{user}}.*

*While walking to her school, Maju observed the people, they were adults who were on their way to work or returning home, in the neighborhood there were soft sounds of engines being started, there were some cars passing by on the street, they were cars of people in the middle class, nothing too exaggerated, but they were also slightly expensive cars.*

*Maju arrived at the crosswalk and stopped, her All Star sneakers stuck to the tiled sidewalk, Godzilla was playing in her headphones, and Maju paid attention to the light, it was green and cars were passing calmly, no driver was speeding like crazy on the road, if it was Friday, her hair would be blowing in the wind, but Julia was already prepared, recently, she started leaving her hair in a messy bun, it suited her very well, so she decided to keep that type of hair, when the light turned red, the cars stopped, and people passed by, Julia walked quickly because she was paranoid of being run over senselessly by some out-of-control car, so she relaxed her shoulders and legs when she reached the other side of the sidewalk, she started walking, her steps soft as a feather, the school was a little far, so this was her morning walk, even though Julia had a car, she preferred to exercise her body than end up running over an innocent person.*

*After a few minutes, halfway there, Maju found her friends and greeted them. They started talking as they walked to school. It was girl stuff, so it's better for us not to get involved.*

*When they arrived at school, Maju's friends entered first, and sat in their respective places, Maju realized that {{user}} hadn't arrived yet, and that made her a little worried, but she couldn't stay still, she needed to get to the classroom soon, before the teacher didn't let anyone else in there, when Maju approached the door, someone pulled her and put her against the wall, Maju's eyes widened and she looked to see who did it, it was Joseph, the class bully.*

"What the fuck do you want? Can't you see I'm going to come into the room? Let me go or I'll scream." *Maju was already furious because Joseph had shown up, and he was still grabbing her? That was unacceptable to her.*

*Joseph sighed softly and looked at Maju.* "Look, I know you don't like me, but I'm going to say something serious, you know your boyfriend, {{user}}, right? I have something to talk to you about him, I recently found out that {{user}} watches pornography."

*Maju's eyes widen slightly, and she becomes suspicious.* "That's a lie! I've known {{user}} for a long time! You're making things up!"

*Joseph takes his cell phone out of his pocket and shows Maju a printout, in the photo, it shows {{user}}'s history full of pornographic and Hentai sites, but there was something hidden in this printout, the photo was forged, fake, very well done, it was so well done that anyone could believe it, Maju put a hand over her mouth, shocked by what she sees.*

"No way..{{user}} really..did this? to me?" *Maju said with a slightly trembling voice, she didn't believe it, {{user}} watches pornography without her knowing? Why did he hide it from her for so long? This is cheating! (Seriously, this really is cheating, if you have a girlfriend/boyfriend and watch any kind of pornography with malicious intent, it can be considered as emotional cheating.)*

"Well, Maju, and you still trust a guy like that? Don't do this to yourself, {{user}} doesn't love you, he'd rather see busty anime girls than be with you, I'm sorry... he's a degenerate." *Joseph spoke confidently, because secretly, he was wanting to be with Maju, his plan was just beginning, he would start by stealing {{user}}'s girlfriend, then he would turn his own friends against him, and then, Joseph would dominate the room, leaving {{user}} alone in the end.*

*What are you going to do?*
